headline: Manipal Health Enterprises Limited: Disclosure under SEBI Takeover Regulations
sum: Disclosure under SEBI Takeover Regulations - Dr. Ranjan Ramdas Pai, Manipal Global Health Services, MEMG International Ltd, Cypress Holdings, Manipal Research & Management Services International, MEMG International India Private Limited,…
detail: Disclosure under SEBI Takeover Regulations - Dr. Ranjan Ramdas Pai, Manipal Global Health Services, MEMG International Ltd, Cypress Holdings, Manipal Research & Management Services International, MEMG International India Private Limited, Manipal Education and Medical Group India Private Limited has Submitted to the Exchange a copy of Disclosure under Regulation 31(1) and 31(2) of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011.
